title: Contrix Cross-Signing Reset
description: Payload content for cx.cross_signing.reset (schema_id cx.schema.cross_signing_reset.v1). High-risk operation that retires the current (SSK, USK) generation and requires one of four kinds of proof — see device-lifecycle.md §14. A successor cx.cross_signing.publish MUST follow within 24h.

previous_generation.description: The generation being retired; MUST equal the currently accepted publish generation.

new_generation.description: Generation that the successor cx.cross_signing.publish will use; MUST equal previous_generation + 1.

reset_reason.description: Free string; SHOULD come from {rotation, compromise, device_loss, policy_required}.

recovery_unlock_proof.description: Recovery-key unlock proof. The schema only encodes wire shape; cryptographic verification is normative in zh/crypto-media/device-lifecycle.md §14.4: (a) recovery_secret_ref MUST resolve to a recovery key id declared in the principal's current DID Document recovery section or recovery_policy; (b) signature MUST verify against the public key bound to that recovery key id over the §14.1 canonical input; (c) unlock_commitment MUST equal SHA-256(HKDF(recovery_secret, info='cx-cross-signing-reset-unlock-v1', salt=canonical_json({principal_id, previous_generation, new_generation, issued_at}))) computed under that recovery secret. Receivers MUST reject the reset if any of (a)/(b)/(c) fails.

recovery_secret_ref.description: Stable identifier of the recovery key entry inside the principal's DID Document / recovery_policy (e.g. `did:webvh:...#recovery-1` or a recovery share id). MUST match an entry that was authoritative at issued_at.

unlock_commitment.description: Replay-binding commitment over the canonical input; see verification rule (c) in description.

device_quorum_proof.description: Device-quorum proof. The schema enforces only the minimum wire shape (threshold>=1, signatures.minItems=1). Cryptographic and quorum verification are normative in zh/crypto-media/device-lifecycle.md §14.4: (a) every signature MUST verify against the public key of an authorized, non-revoked device in the principal's current device set at issued_at, over the §14.1 canonical input; (b) signatures MUST be deduplicated by device_id; (c) the count of valid, deduplicated signatures MUST be >= threshold; (d) threshold MUST equal the current `recovery_policy.device_quorum.threshold` (or equivalent published quorum policy) at issued_at — a smaller threshold supplied by the issuer MUST be rejected as `failed_precondition` reason=`cross_signing_reset_quorum_below_policy`. Receivers MUST reject the reset if any of (a)-(d) fails.

threshold.description: The quorum threshold the issuer claims to satisfy. MUST equal the principal's currently published recovery_policy device-quorum threshold; receivers MUST cross-check (see description rule (d)).

signatures.description: minItems=1 is the schema floor only; reducer-side verification requires deduplicated valid signatures count >= threshold per description rule (c).
